AddCaseUpdateRequest.description:
An internal note, or (visibility public) a message the requester will
see on their request.
AddCaseUpdateRequest.title: AddCaseUpdateRequest

AnonymousRequestReceipt.description:
A request sent without an account. The access code is shown once:
with the request's number it is the only way back to the request.
AnonymousRequestReceipt.title: AnonymousRequestReceipt

AppUser.description: The authenticated caller as a Hacksgiving user (app.users).
AppUser.title: AppUser

CaseCategory.description: ComForce MKE's services (models/routing.py Service), plus other.
CaseCategory.title: CaseCategory

CaseInsights.description: Everything on the dashboard, computed from the case tables.
CaseInsights.title: CaseInsights

CaseUpdate.description:
One entry in a case's history: a note, a message to the requester, or
a change the system recorded.
CaseUpdate.title: CaseUpdate

ContactMethod.description: How a resident wants to be reached. `none`: don't reach out at all.
ContactMethod.title: ContactMethod

CreateCaseRequest.description: A case a worker opens (a phone call, a walk-in, an incident).
CreateCaseRequest.title: CreateCaseRequest

apply_url.description: An http(s) link to apply or sign up.
apply_url.title: Apply Url

schedule.description: When: hours, days, or the commitment.
schedule.title: Schedule

CreateTaskRequest.description:
A task a worker adds to a case. Without `assigned_worker_id` it
follows the case (whoever holds it).
CreateTaskRequest.title: CreateTaskRequest

DraftMessage.description:
A message to the requester. Sent only if a worker posts it as a
public update.
DraftMessage.title: DraftMessage

ReplyRequest.description:
The requester's answer on their own request. Staff see it in the case
history.
ReplyRequest.title: ReplyRequest

StaffStatus.description: The caller's own standing, for the app to decide what to show.
StaffStatus.title: StaffStatus

SubmitRequest.description:
A community member asking for help. Who they are comes from their
sign-in. Priority, status and assignee are for workers to set: a body
that sends them (or any unknown field) is rejected with 422.

category.description: Leave out to let ComForce sort it (the AI router, when it's configured).

contact_method.description: Call or text needs `contact_phone`. Leave out when the form didn't ask.

safe_to_contact.description: It's safe to call or leave a voicemail (or to text).
safe_to_contact.title: Safe To Contact

SubmitRequest.title: SubmitRequest

Task.description:
A piece of work on a case: generated when the case comes in
(services/task.py), or added by a worker.
Task.title: Task

UpdateCaseRequest.description:
Only the fields sent change. Send `assigned_worker_id: null` to
unassign.
UpdateCaseRequest.title: UpdateCaseRequest

active.description: false closes the posting (hidden from residents); true reopens it.
active.title: Active

UpdateTaskRequest.description:
Only the fields sent change. Send `assigned_worker_id: null` to hand
the task back to whoever holds the case.
UpdateTaskRequest.title: UpdateTaskRequest

get.description:
The case queue. Filters combine; open cases first, then by priority
(critical first), then newest. `q` matches the case number, title,
description or location.

schema.title: Response List Cases V1 Cases Get

post.description: A case a worker opens: a phone call, a walk-in, an incident.

get.description: The latest updates across all cases, newest first.

schema.title: Response Recent Activity V1 Cases Activity Get

get.description: Dashboard numbers, counted from the cases themselves.
A case with its full history and referrals.

patch.description:
Triage and progress: status, priority, category, assignee (null to
unassign) and details. Each change is recorded in the history.

post.description:
A draft update to the requester, for the worker to edit and send (as a
public update). Never sent by itself. 503 when AI isn't configured.

Resources that fit the case, each with a reason, chosen only from the
resource directory. Without AI (`method: rules`), the resources in the
case's category.
A short summary of the case and its history. 503 when AI isn't configured.
Connect the case with a community resource. 409 if it's already on it.

patch.description:
Track a referral: suggested, shared, accepted, completed or declined,
and record its outcome.

post.description:
Add a task to the case, optionally due at a time and assigned to a
worker (422 if they aren't staff). Without an assignee it follows the
case. Noted in the case history.

An internal note (default), or with `visibility: public` a message
the requester sees on their request.

get.description: Liveness only: no database round-trip and no deployment metadata.

schema.title: Response Health Check V1 Health Get

get.description: The signed-in user; the first call provisions them.

patch.description:
Sets the caller's display name and/or IANA timezone. The app sends the
name from the ID token after sign-in, since access tokens don't carry it.
An email address is never kept as a name.

get.description:
Open opportunities, newest first. `q` matches the title,
organization, description or location.

parameters.description: Staff only; ignored for everyone else.
parameters.name: include_closed

schema.description: Staff only; ignored for everyone else.
schema.title: Include Closed
Response List Opportunities V1 Opportunities Get

post.description: Post a volunteer or job opportunity. Staff only.

get.description: One opportunity. A closed one is 404 except to staff.

patch.description: Close (`active: false`) or reopen a posting. Staff only.

post.description:
Ask ComForce MKE for help without signing in. Same body as
`POST /v1/requests`. Keep the access code: it's shown only this once.
429 after a few requests from one address in an hour.

get.description:
A request sent without an account, with its public updates. 404 for
a wrong number or code alike.

post.description: Answer on a request sent without an account.

get.description: The caller's own requests, newest first.

schema.title: Response List My Requests V1 Requests Get

post.description:
Ask ComForce MKE for help. The request becomes a case in the worker
queue with status new. Leave `category` out to have it sorted
automatically (when AI routing is configured; otherwise it is `other`).

get.description:
One of the caller's requests, with its public updates (status changes
and messages from ComForce). 404 for anyone else's.

post.description:
Answer on one of the caller's requests (shown to them and to staff).
404 for anyone else's.

get.description:
Active resources, real ones before samples. `q` matches the name,
description or neighborhood. Rows with `is_sample: true` are
demonstration data, not real services.

schema.title: Response List Resources V1 Resources Get

post.description: Add a resource to the directory. Staff only.

Picks the ComForce MKE service for a free-text request for help.
Signed-in callers only, so the OpenAI key can't be spent by anyone.

Makes the caller the first staff admin. Works only while nobody is
staff yet (409 after that); from then on admins add workers.

get.description: The caller's role, so the app knows whether to open the worker portal.
Everyone who has signed in, staff first. Admins only.

schema.title: Response List Users V1 Staff Users Get

patch.description:
Make someone a worker or admin, or back to a member. Admins only, and
not for their own role.

get.description: Everyone a case can be assigned to, with their open case counts.

schema.title: Response List Workers V1 Staff Workers Get

get.description:
Open tasks by due time (soonest first). `mine` keeps the caller's:
tasks assigned to them, and unassigned tasks on cases they hold.

schema.title: Response List Tasks V1 Tasks Get

patch.description:
Mark a task done (or open again), or hand it to another worker
(`assigned_worker_id: null` gives it back to whoever holds the case).
Finishing a task is noted in the case history.

get.description: The public app actions a phone agent may accurately describe.

schema.title: Response Follow Ups V1 Voice Follow Ups Get

post.description: Create a short-lived code the agent can read aloud to the caller.
Attach one call to the signed-in account without storing a phone number.

get.description: Return allowlisted routes; only approved destinations expose a number.

schema.title: Response Resources V1 Voice Resources Get

post.description: Use the app's classifier and keep its structured route on the call.
Accept signed post-call analysis; verify bytes before parsing JSON.
